theorem lg_target {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) : ↑⌊x⌋₊.primeCounting ≤ Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x := by
  have h_log_sqrt : Real.log √x = Real.log x / 2 := Real.log_sqrt (by linarith)
  let y := Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x
  have h_y_pos : 0 < y := by {
    rw h_log_sqrt at hx,
    exact Real.mul_log_pos hx
  }
  have h_floor_le_x : ↑⌊x⌋₊ ≤ x := by {
    rw floor_le,
    exact hx
  }
  have h_floor_prime_counting_le_x : ↑⌊x⌋₊.primeCounting ≤ x := by {
    apply primeCounting_le_self
  }
  have h_real_log_4 : 0 < Real.log 4 := by {
    apply Real.log_pos,
    exact lt_one_of_lt_one (by linarith)
  }
  have h_real_log_sqrt : 0 < Real.log √x := by {
    rw h_log_sqrt,
    exact Real.mul_log_pos hx
  }
  have h_denom_pos : 0 < Real.log √x := h_real_log_sqrt
  have h_z_bound : Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x ≤ √x + √x := by {
    have h1 : Real.log 4 ≤ √x + √x := by {
      have h2 : 0 < √x := by {
        rw sqrt_pos,
        exact hx
      }
